slides.title: Thick crema does not mean good coffee
slides.subtitle: Some machines make it with almost any coffee.

slides.truth: Crema hints at freshness and extraction, but it says little about flavor. A shot can look rich and still taste bitter.

slides.title: Some machines make foam anyway
slides.body: Machines that push coffee through a tiny outlet whip air into it. The foam looks like crema, but the flavor does not always match.
slides.highlight: Looks like crema. Tastes like anything.

slides.label: The tip
slides.body: Taste before you judge. If the foam is thick but the cup is bitter or flat, the crema told you very little.

slides.title: Judge the cup, not the foam
slides.body: Foam can come from the coffee or the machine. Taste decides.
